Consider the picture shown above. Find the **exact** value of $|a+b|.$

$|a+b|=$
{{field-1}}$\,\text{mm}.$
question.worked_solution:
We use the triangle law of addition for $a$ and $b.$ We can start $a$ from an arbitrary point on the plane. The resultant goes from the start of $a$ to the head of $b.$

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/linear/14251309/assets/41bd69400fe98c2f8ab964c76fa295a6624f83d51fc720ba251ae4c618f87954.png)

Now, in $△AHB,$ we have $m∠AHB={90}^{∘},$ $AH=30\,\text{mm},$ and $BH=10\,\text{mm}.$ So, the Pythagorean theorem gives

$$
\begin{aligned}|a+b| & =AB \\  & =\sqrt{A{H}^{2}+B{H}^{2}} \\  & =\sqrt{{30}^{2}+{10}^{2}} \\  & =\sqrt{900+100} \\  & =\sqrt{1000} \\  & =10\sqrt{10}\,\text{mm}.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, $|a+b|=10\sqrt{10}\,\text{mm}.$
